Detailed Description

plugin that creates a file-info "tooltip"

this plugin creates tooltips as shown in http://evidence.sourceforge.net/screenshots/tooltip2.jpg

(if you are looking for a simple tooltip plugin to modify, you might prefer tt_traditional and friends; this one is slightly more involved because of the code that tries to decide which boxes should go where.)

a lot of tunables exist as defines and should be turned into properties at some point. ###

Define Documentation

#define COL   255
 

valid colours are 0 and 255.

choose any other value, and you're on your own.

#define LINES_FOR_ALL   0
 

draw lines for each text-line (1), not just for each text-block (0) instead, a function may be given to randomly select text-lines that will get a line-object.

the first text-line of a text-block always will.

#define LINES_FOR_ALL   (RND(3)<1)
 

draw lines for each text-line (1), not just for each text-block (0) instead, a function may be given to randomly select text-lines that will get a line-object.

the first text-line of a text-block always will.

void* tt_new (  void *  data,
int  x,
int  y,
file_info *  fi
) 
 

create a tooltip.

no assumptions about the nature of the tooltip are made; for all the main application knows, the plugin might read the info to the user aloud.

Returns:
a handle to pass to tt_dst() when destroy the tooltip.
Parameters:
data - the icon-list the tooltip is related to
x - x-position of the icon the info is for
y - y-position of the icon the info is for
fi - the file we're displaying info for
